**Goldman Sachs reported revenues (net of interest expense) of $58.28 billion for fiscal year 2025**, as disclosed in their 10-K filing submitted to the SEC on February 25, 2026.

A few things worth noting:
- Goldman reports **"Revenues Net of Interest Expense"** as its primary top-line metric, which is standard for large financial institutions. This nets out interest costs directly from revenues, rather than showing them separately as an expense.
- This figure encompasses revenue from all of Goldman's business segments, including Global Banking & Markets, Asset & Wealth Management, and Platform Solutions.
